title: QD-VMR: Query Debiasing with Contextual Understanding Enhancement for Video Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: While cross-modal interaction approaches have shown progress in filtering out query-irrelevant information in videos, they assume the precise alignment between the query semantics and the corresponding video moments, potentially overlooking the misunderstanding of the natural language semantics.
